chunks: With this chain of transmission, from Sa'd, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-'Abbas ibn Ma'ruf, from 'Ali ibn Mahziyar, from Hammad ibn 'Isa and Fadalah ibn Ayyub, from Mu'awiyah ibn 'Ammar, who said:
I asked Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام about a menstruating woman who sweats in her clothes: may she perform salat (prayer) in them before washing them? He said: Yes, there is no harm.

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or objection

ai.seo_question: Can one pray in clothes that a menstruating woman has sweated in before washing them?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that the sweat of a menstruating woman does not render her clothing impure such that it must be washed before salat (prayer). It indicates the taharah of such sweat and removes hardship in practical rulings related to ritual purity and worship.
